content.text:
I reviewed the runner-settings implementation, validated the frontend and backend test suites (all passing), and corrected one regression in `api/flow/runnerRoutes.js` where a recent edit had stripped the `runOnBranch`/`customBranch` payload and the current-stage fallback from `ciPayloadFor` (which would let Runners silently execute primary/custom command stages in task worktrees, breaking publish/deploy flows). Restored the original, branch-safe version of that function.

The System Settings tab already shows the Runner configuration surface (roster, approve/deny, project picker, tools, directory fields with save confirmation, job switches), persisted operator config is separate from heartbeat facts, and unit/integration coverage passes.

KAINBAIN_VERDICT: PASS
